# dsh-math-render
A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin that renders LaTeX in the web GUI:
- **Your own message bubble** — `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)` and `\[...\]` in a message you sent re

nder as formulas, in place.
- **Composer draft preview** — while the draft contains a formula, a str
ip above the input renders it live. With no formula in the draft the strip does not exist at all.
Assistant replies already render through the shell's KaTeX pipeline; this plugin does not touch them
ssistant replies already render through the shell's KaTeX pipeline; this plugin does not touch them.

Installing from a checkout instead
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Same mechanism: the package declares a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `dsh plugin add` records it in the pro
file and its row mounts at the next boot.
## How it works
| Seat | What it does | Why that seat |
| `conversation.user.text.node`, key `math`, `priority: 100` | Renders one TeX run through the shell
's own `MarkdownText`, the same KaTeX pipeline assistant replies use | ui-conversation 0.2.1 parses
a user message into JSON nodes with pure rules and dispatches each node to a keyed inline renderer.
`math` is a free key, so the shipped `text`, `session`, `skill`, `command`, `file`, `folder` and `se

cret` nodes keep their own cells |
| a `math` rule in `uiConversation.userText` at `order: 40` | Tur
ns `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)` and `\[...\]` spans into those nodes | The rule registry is the int
ended pre-render seam: it is pure, revision-tracked, and a failing rule leaves the whole message as

plain text |
| `conversation.input.dock`, id `math-preview`, `order: 5` | The draft preview strip ab
ove the composer | That seat is a session-scoped list seat rendered with the input snapshot (`draft`
included), so no internal service has to be reached; `order: 5` keeps it ahead of the shipped queue
no internal service has to be reached; `order: 5` keeps it ahead of the shipped queue dock at `20` |
The host half is a package anchor plus one read-only diagnostic route. It holds no state and touches
a package anchor plus one read-only diagnostic route. It holds no state and touches nothing at boot.
This plugin used to shadow `conversation.chat.node` and rebuild the whole user bubble from copied CS
S. 0.2.1 removed the `projectUserText` primitive that approach depended on, so 2.0.0 moved to the us
er-text extension point instead: the shipped bubble keeps its own DOM, geometry, attachments, copy a
ction, reference chips and secret masking, and only the formula spans are handed to the shell render
on, reference chips and secret masking, and only the formula spans are handed to the shell renderer.
## Behaviour
- **A message without TeX renders exactly as the shipped bubble does.** The message is still parsed
and rendered by the shipped user-text document and plain-text run; the plugin only adds one node key

.
- **Backticks are the escape hatch.** TeX inside a fenced code block or an inline code span stays

literal, and so does `\$`.
- **Currency is not mistaken for math.** `costs $5 and $10` stays prose:

a closing `$` glued to a digit is refused, as is space-padded content.
- **Bad TeX is not hidden.**
It goes to the shell renderer, so a syntax error shows KaTeX's error output, exactly as in an assist

ant reply.
- **A failing rule or renderer falls back to raw text.** The user-text document keeps the
whole original message as plain text when a rule throws, and the slot boundary contains a crashing

node renderer, so the worst case is "no effect", not a broken transcript or a missing bubble.
- **No
preview on the new-session hero composer.** The host renders that seat only for a bound session; it
appears once the first message puts you inside the conversation.
## Limitations
- **Requires dsh 0.2.1-rc.1 or newer.** The `uiConversation.userText` rule registry and the `convers

ation.user.text.node` seat were introduced there. On an older shell the plugin stays inert.
- **The
composer preview is a preview, not inline WYSIWYG.** The composer is a Lexical editor and the plugin
seams expose no inline widget. Typing `$x^2$` renders in the strip above the input, not inside the

editable area.
- **`dsh.bundle` and a hand-written `file://` row are mutually exclusive.** Two activ
e Loader sources for one package name is an error; install it one way.
## Diagnostics
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Loopback `Host` only. `mounted` proves the row resolved; `clientRegistered` proves the browser half
is in the client module graph. In the page console, `document.querySelector('style[data-plugin-css="
dsh-math-render/styles.css"]')` is non-null once the browser half has loaded.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No harness, no browser, no network. 36 assertions over the tokenizer (delimiters, display math acros
s lines, currency and code-span refusals, exact source ranges), the `math` rule's candidate contract
, the shapes both seats are registered with, the components (TeX routes to `MarkdownText`, ranges an
d malformed nodes degrade instead of throwing, the preview's zero footprint), and — when the shell's
own slot registry is reachable — that the `math` key occupies one cell without displacing the shipp
t registry is reachable — that the `math` key occupies one cell without displacing the shipped keys.
## Compatibility
Written and verified against **dsh 0.2.1-rc.2** (client packages `0.2.1-rc.2`, DSH Desktop 2.0.18).
The `uiConversation.userText` rule contract, the keyed `conversation.user.text.node` seat, the free
`math` key, and the `conversation.input.dock` render props were read out of that version's sources.
Newer shell versions may move any of them.
